name: musiccontext
description: Music direction for AI agents: turn a video into a structured Music Direction Plan (story -> direction -> candidate selection -> sync), search a local library, generate music offline, and render the mixed video with FFmpeg.
notes: Codex support is UNVERIFIED in this build. This manifest mirrors the Claude Code plugin (same ./skills directory, same `musiccontext mcp` stdio server) and has only been checked for valid JSON, not against a published Codex plugin schema.
